title: CORE: A Retrieve-then-Edit Framework for Counterfactual Data Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the statistical correlation between specific individual words/tokens and class labels (calculating z-statistics for the competency problem) to detect reliance on lexical dataset artifacts rather than actual reasoning.

Measuring the diversity of generated counterfactuals using text similarity metrics (Self-BLEU, Levenshtein edit distance) and classifying perturbation types (e.g., negation, insertion, lexical change) to ensure the data augmentation is not biased towards trivial or restricted heuristic edits.
